selection.query: OPEN_ACCESS:y AND HAS_FT:y AND TITLE:("SiC" OR "silicon carbide" OR "GaN" OR "gallium nitride" OR "MOSFET" OR "MOSFETs" OR "transparent conducting" OR "silicon photovoltaic" OR "silicon photovoltaics" OR "photovoltaic modules" OR "epitaxial" OR "epitaxy" OR "chemical vapor deposition" OR "chemical vapour deposition" OR "wafer" OR "wafers")
local_filters: a title term in the title
no exclusion term in the title
selection.order: PMCIDs sorted as strings, then random.Random(0).shuffle
selection.superscripts: inline, as in the SOFC corpus
selection.words: chem_tokenize.ChemWordTokenizer (ChemDataExtractor 1.3.0), then ASCII hyphens inside a word made words of their own, space-separated

settings.skipped_sections: ^[\d.\s]*(acknowledg|funding|conflicts? of interest|competing interests?|author contributions?|data availability|availability of data|ethic|abbreviations|nomenclature|supplementary|references|declarations?|disclosure)
